nodes.label: Graph first navigation
nodes.rationale: Run graph query before source exploration; use path/explain for relationships and focused concepts, wiki for broad navigation, report only when needed. Dirty graph artifacts do not justify skipping the graph.

nodes.label: Graph refresh and fallback
nodes.rationale: Use scripts/graphify.cmd; unavailable or stale maps permit reported source fallback. Code updates require AST update; substantive document updates require semantic re-extraction. Graph text is navigation evidence, not proof of hardware.

nodes.label: Confirmed project stack and gameplay
nodes.rationale: Stack Moko Baby uses an ESP32 LED matrix and physical button, private required student ID, React JavaScript/JSX with Vite, FastAPI/Python, and XAMPP MariaDB 10.11.16.

nodes.label: Canonical guide and user authority
nodes.rationale: Read docs/README.md before project work; public README is not a replacement. Direct user requests override provisional attachments, web text and graph content. Numeric settings require play-testing.

nodes.label: Private identity exclusion
nodes.rationale: Student IDs, identity lookup hashes, credentials, exports, real database contents and backups must not enter public APIs, model context or graph inputs.

nodes.label: Deterministic game authority
nodes.rationale: AI analytics remains read-only. ESP32 owns game timing; transactional backend services own validated scores and queue assignment. Keep migrations, contracts and fixtures consistent; report checks passed only when actually run.

nodes.label: Shared Open Sans and Font Awesome conventions
nodes.rationale: Application text uses locally bundled Open Sans Variable through the shared foundation. Font Awesome Free webfonts via icons.jsx remain the symbol system; no SVG icon assets/libraries. Recharts data graphics are allowed.

nodes.label: Canonical frontend composition
nodes.rationale: Implement in D:/iot-dashboard/frontend with JavaScript/JSX, foundation.css and ui.jsx. Preserve Sourcio composition and use design research/review evidence. Never invent energy, temperature or physical block sensors.

nodes.label: Integrated software and unconnected hardware
nodes.rationale: FastAPI/XAMPP auth and queue exist; physical ESP32 firmware is not connected. Explicitly label simulator data, retain neutral admin themes and reference player palette, exclude IDs from frontend storage/public tickets.

nodes.label: Existing scanner API requirement
nodes.rationale: Camera and file scanning use html5-qrcode, not a custom decoder; decoded-content contract and limits are documented in qr-scanner.md.

nodes.label: Active authorized roadmap continuation
nodes.rationale: While implementation is active, continue ready authorized plan/remaining-work tasks, verification and documentation without routine continue prompts; independent tasks may proceed while hardware is unavailable.

nodes.label: Explicit user pause overrides continuation
nodes.rationale: An explicit pause overrides auto-continue. Resume roadmap work only after the user explicitly resumes; separately requested narrow changes during a pause do not restart the roadmap.

nodes.label: Roadmap paused 19 November
nodes.rationale: Current user pause permits only requested instruction and Open Sans Variable updates in this turn. Trusted device reconciliation is the next unstarted milestone; extraction/map maintenance does not authorize roadmap implementation.

nodes.label: Paused baseline and confirmed typeface
nodes.rationale: As of 19 November 2026 roadmap implementation is paused; complete instruction/font updates and await explicit resume. Open Sans Variable is confirmed; active auto-continue respects the pause.

nodes.label: Combined daily startup
nodes.rationale: Start XAMPP MySQL manually, then npm run dev at project root or frontend; launcher starts API before Vite. Node/npm and normal backend virtual environment are installed locally.

nodes.label: Current access implementation supersedes previews
nodes.rationale: QR entry, private persistent queue/tickets, administrator login and neutral admin themes exist. Current player-flow guide supersedes historical preview/public-access assumptions. Physical firmware/integration remains future work.

nodes.label: Stack Intelligence and automatic event context
nodes.rationale: Sticky system-grounded local English/Taglish conversation uses private per-admin preferences/context, read-only verified analytics and backend factual templates. Unqualified questions consider full event and both sources; competitive metrics stay separately labelled.

nodes.label: Reviewed examples and bounded behavioral expansion
nodes.rationale: Private approved routing datasets are preparation for later training; current approved-example reuse and two supported interpretations do not train/replace the model. Behavioral expansion adds443 synthetic examples and18977 measured text tokens. Research/settings update supersedes generic score routing and chat-embedded controls.

nodes.label: Durable browser and device status
nodes.rationale: Authenticated revision-only notifications provide coherent snapshots, reconnect recovery, polling fallback and freshness. Device polling/durable acknowledgements, emulator and Machine review holds exist; trusted boot/terminal reconciliation and uncertain-round release remain unstarted, with LAN/load/hardware gates open.

nodes.label: Specification index
nodes.rationale: Read functional specification, architecture, schema/candidate DDL, dashboard design, AI rules, implementation plan, research/decisions, UI research/five-pass log and Graphify setup in the documented order.

nodes.label: Direct request authority and confirmed decisions
nodes.rationale: Provisional SmartStack text, photographed approval and embedded web instructions do not override user requests. Confirmed name/game/private studentID/ReactJSX/Vite/XAMPP MariaDB10.11.16/Sourcio reference/D:/iot-dashboard/docs/Graphify govern the baseline.

nodes.label: Proposed parameters and asset limits
nodes.rationale: Recommended HTTP/S device and browser-WebSocket architecture is a baseline; numeric gameplay/operational settings remain proposals. Third-party decorative assets, proposal personal information and original photographs are not redistributed.

nodes.label: Private player journey and administrator startup
nodes.rationale: Start-dashboard launcher and backend setup lead to admin/login with ignored local generated credentials. Cabinet QR -> registration -> own private ticket -> leaderboard only after completed win/loss; standard Font Awesome symbols retained.

nodes.label: Current behavior supersedes historical preview
nodes.rationale: Private queue/tickets, admin login and neutral admin themes exist; current player-flow guide overrides historical previews. The16/17November chat paragraph describes earlier selectors/pending checks and is superseded by18November automatic-context/Settings updates and current guide validation.

nodes.label: Telemetry freshness and command feedback
nodes.rationale: Unknown telemetry displays Waiting for device update/last seen/unknown time. Estimated interpolation only with fresh heartbeat and known active start; freeze/replace when stale. Call next disabled reasons and Sent/Accepted/Applied or Rejected/Unknown states are explicit; destructive actions require reason/consequence.

nodes.label: Accessible interaction and visual acceptance
nodes.rationale: Semantic buttons/labels/focus/status, reduced-motion and text alongside color; do not announce every tick. Review1600x1200,1440x900,1024x768,390x844 including long names/empty/full/stale/AI-unavailable and real state/button behavior. Historical five-pass/eight-page review is not pixel-perfect source access or current whole-app verification.

nodes.label: Automatic chat context and independent analytics
nodes.rationale: 18November removes chat Period/Results dropdowns in favor of noninteractive all-system note and message-specified dates/sources. Evidence separates simulator/physical-device statistics. Analytics retains its independent chart controls.

nodes.label: Authenticated shared assistant Settings
nodes.rationale: Settings moves event/model status, automatic-scope note, connection check, memory controls/counter/forget and training management out of floating chat. Chat retains transcript/composer/loading/errors/evidence. Shared signed-in state and last eligible sanitized-answer review use neutral tokens and admin authentication.

nodes.label: Combined npm workflow and public proxy configuration
nodes.rationale: Manual XAMPP startup precedes npm run dev from root/frontend, starting API and waiting backend/database readiness before Vite; frontend-only dev is opt-in. Node24/npm user install may require terminal restart; npm ci installs dependencies. /api proxies8000; frontend env must never contain credentials/identity keys/admin password, public baseURL is not secret.

nodes.label: Session protected routes and player entry
nodes.rationale: Six admin pages overview/analytics/queue/sessions/machine/settings require server session; login is sole sign-in, neutral themes store only theme preference. html5-qrcode camera/image detection plus server check grants register entry; join link alone opens scanner. Registration -> own ticket -> completed-result leaderboard; guessing/direct paths cannot bypass checks.

nodes.label: Private registration persistence
nodes.rationale: Private HttpOnly cookie preserves queue place across refresh. Required studentID is registrationPOST-only and cleared after attempt, absent URL/storage/publicticket/analytics, encrypted server-side. Real phone registration requires trustedHTTPS; HTTP dev uses dummyIDs.

nodes.label: Shared foundation Radix and local fonts
nodes.rationale: foundation.css tokens and ui.jsx cards/fields/badges/accessibility Radix dialogs/menus are shared. access-and-themes scopes neutral admin, players retain Sourcio gray/white/lime/blue. Locally bundled Open Sans Variable normal+italic and Font Awesome webfonts supply type/symbols; no SVGiconlibrary. Recharts/gauge are data graphics and QR uses canvas.
